title: Consulting for a jeans company on shading and stitching

tellings.quote: I remember the the the CEO, I won't mention the company, but the CEO of the company jumping out of his chair, going up to the screen and and and going, "Our jeans make my butt look bad."

plain: A researcher named Don Hoffman, who studies how perception works, says he once advised a jeans company on how shading and stitching change the way jeans look on the body. He tells Michels that during one presentation the company's CEO, whose company he won't name, jumped out of his chair, went up to the screen and said, "Our jeans make my butt look bad." He tells it as something he saw himself, to show how small visual cues change what people think they see.
